transcript.text: Hi, I'm Sam, Wattle's AI claims assistant. I'm here to help, and you can talk to a person at any time. Is anyone hurt or in danger right now?
I want to check you're safe first. Please reply with one word: "safe", "hurt", or "person" if you'd like to talk to someone now.

I've asked a person to help you. Someone from our team is joining this chat now.

If anyone is hurt or in danger, call 000 now.

input.summary: Customer opened chat with "hhhelp car". Asked twice whether anyone is hurt or in danger; replies were unclear ("asdf car thing hmm", "??? the the"). Safety and injury status unknown. Customer may be having real difficulty communicating, possibly unwell or shaken. No identity verified, no claim details collected. Please check on their safety urgently.

output.message: A team member is joining the chat.
